decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for a gaming centre and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D2 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 8am to 10pm.

Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted for a gaming centre purpose shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 7 - Details of any external plant shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to the occupation of the approved use.

Condition : 8 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the use as a gaming centre would not harm neighbours' living conditions or the retail function of the Hounslow Town centre in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies IMP 2.2 (Regeneration of Hounslow Town Centre), ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities), ENV-B.1.9 (Safe and Security), S.1.1 (Main Shopping Areas), S.1.2 (Non Retail Uses in Primary Shopping Frontages), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments) of the Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Change of use from Bank to Gaming centre(D2)
